card.name: Just before Snellen acuity values like 20/200
card.fires_on: The space or small word (than, to) right before a visual acuity fraction such as 20/200 or 20/100, in ocular side-effect text about best corrected vision. It also fires on the first digit 2 of the fraction.

modes.label: Gap before acuity
modes.description: The space or linking word just before 20/200 after phrases like 'less than' or 'worse than'.
modes.example: best corrected vision less than<< >>20/200 in one

modes.label: Linking word
modes.description: The word than or to directly ahead of the acuity value.
modes.example: Decline to Snellen Equivalent BCVA of worse<< than>> 20/200 Consider

modes.label: First digit
modes.example: best corrected vision less than <<2>>0/200 in one

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to write the Snellen fraction digits, with no clear effect from the listed tokens.
card.plain: It fires just before a vision measurement like 20/200 is written out in eye-toxicity text.
